entry.title: Some thoughts about the DEB (dynamic energy budget)

link.title: Some thoughts about the DEB (dynamic energy budget)

entry.content:
The Dynamic Energy Budget theory has been introduced by S.A.L.M. Kooijman in the 90’. This is a theory, which means it is a set of equations that are supposed to describe reality. Authors who started or contributed to this theory describe it as the best tested quantitative theory in biology \citep{marques_2018, kooijman_2009}

To use display mode, again surround your expression with $$ and place it as a separate paragraph. Here is an example:

\[\sum_{k=1}^\infty |\langle x, e_k \rangle|^2 \leq \|x\|^2\]
entry.summary: this is "the best tested quantitative theory in biology"
